market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: The 2028 election is highly uncertain, with many potential Republican candidates (DeSantis, Haley, Cruz, Hawley, etc.) and a likely open primary. Rubio's establishment profile may struggle against a Trump-aligned challenger, and even if nominated, the general election is a toss-up. His true win probability is well below the market's 14.2%, likely around 9%.
evidence_points: Many plausible Republican rivals (DeSantis, Haley, etc.) diffuse nomination odds
Trend toward MAGA-style candidates in GOP primaries hurts Rubio
General election will be competitive regardless of nominee
Long time horizon magnifies uncertainty and candidate field size
sources_consulted: historical betting market data on distant election cycles
2024 primary polling and candidate favorability trends
